map.珍珠品质分级标准 使用指南: Pearl Quality Grading Standard User Guide
map.依据光泽、光洁度、形状、颜色与大小五大要素对珍珠品质打分，按各维度权重综合评定等: Scores pearl quality on five elements - luster, surface smoothness, shape, color and size - and combines the per-dimension weights into a grade with a stated grading basis, suited to selection, appraisal or teaching reference.
map.按多维度给珍珠定级，判断价值。: Grade pearls across multiple dimensions and judge value.
map.对比不同等级的外观差异。: Compare the appearance differences between levels.
map.：以光泽为主、瑕疵形状匹配为辅：4 级最强光泽近乎镜面、5 无瑕级稀少；3 级强: Luster first, blemish shape match second: grade 4 has the strongest near-mirror luster, and the flawless grade 5 is very rare; grade 3 is strong luster with minor blemishes, grade 2 moderate, grade 1 weak luster with visible blemishes. The higher the grade the rarer and more valuable.
map.：多珠首饰额外看大小/色/光的匹配度；同串偏差小(匹配 4 级)比单珠等级更影响: For multi-stone jewelry also weigh the match of size, color and luster; a strand with small deviation (match grade 4) affects overall value more than the grade of a single stone.
map.光泽为什么最重要？: Why is luster the most important?
map.光泽(晕彩)是珍珠灵魂，强光泽可弥补微瑕；瑕疵不可逆但可被设计与镶嵌遮，故分级以: Luster (iridescence) is the soul of a pearl, and strong luster can make up for small blemishes; blemishes are irreversible but can be hidden by design and mounting, so grading puts luster first.
